edition: MIME Sniffing Living Standard, whatwg/mimesniff commit ba4b3c3
name: MIME Sniffing Standard
statement: The MIME Sniffing Standard's source: the byte patterns that identify a resource's MIME type, including audio/midi for a Standard MIDI File (MThd header) and audio/wave for a RIFF WAVE file, the declared types of the MIDI and BWF artifacts of a Verdant Prism, which IANA does not register (REQ-ENGINE-MUSIC, REQ-ENGINE-AUDIO-FILE).
